title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
description: A comforting weeknight pasta tossed with ripe tomatoes, basil and a silky cream sauce.
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté tomatoes until soft, then stir in cream.
Toss pasta with sauce and fresh basil. Serve warm.

title: Rainbow Harvest Bowl
description: A bright, nourishing bowl of greens, creamy avocado, chickpeas and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Rinse and drain the chickpeas.
Slice the vegetables and avocado.
Arrange everything over greens and drizzle with lemon dressing.

title: Fluffy Sunday Pancakes
description: Golden, tender pancakes made for slow mornings and generous maple syrup.
instructions: Whisk flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Add milk and egg; stir just until combined.
Cook small scoops on a warm buttered pan until golden on both sides.

title: Golden Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: Creamy coconut, warming spices and tender chickpeas come together in one pot.
instructions: Soften diced onion in a little oil.
Add curry powder and stir until fragrant.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Herb Salmon
description: A simple, flaky salmon dinner brightened with fresh lemon and herbs.
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray.
Season salmon with olive oil, lemon, dill, salt and pepper.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until flaky.

title: Roasted Tomato Soup
description: Deeply savory roasted tomatoes blended into a velvety bowl of comfort.
instructions: Roast tomatoes and garlic at 200°C until caramelized.
Blend with warm vegetable stock until smooth.
Stir in cream and season to taste.

title: Smoky Bean Tacos
description: Weeknight-friendly black bean tacos with a bright lime slaw.
instructions: Warm beans with cumin and smoked paprika.
Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice.
Fill warm tortillas with beans and slaw.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
description: Crackly-topped, deeply chocolatey brownies with a soft fudgy center.
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk in sugar and eggs, then fold in flour.
Bake in a lined pan at 180°C for 22–25 minutes.
